steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow used for an RFQ.
Provide the required event title.
Configure the event with an RFQ stage.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add one product for the bid and counter-offer flow.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet.
Commit a bidding schedule so the RFQ can be published.
Invite one QA vendor to submit the original bid.
Publish the RFQ so the vendor can bid.
Verify the RFQ reached a published project page.
Verify the original vendor bid was accepted.
Open the buyer comparison grid to send the counter offer.
Send the buyer's ₹80 counter offer against the vendor's bid.
Verify the counter offer is pending for the vendor.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open the RFQ pricing round where the counter offer is received.
Verify the vendor-side counter-offer banner is visible.
